Medium Affected: AIR

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.347043, -79.862394 (Approximated from premise)
Report Description//////THIS IS AN UPDATE FOR NRC REPORT NUMBER 1343600./////// UPDATED INFO: - INVESTIGATION IS BEING COMPLETED BY THE ALLEGHENY COUNTY FIRE MARSHALL AND IS IN CONTROL OF THE SITE. - DAMAGE OCCURRED TO A CUSTOMER OWNED UNDERGROUND BURIED HOUSE LINE (NON-JURISDICTIONAL). THE DAMAGE MAY HAVE CAUSED THE RELEASE OF NATURAL GAS INTO THE BUILDING AND THE INCIDENT IS STILL UNDER INVESTIGATION. - TWO PEOPLE WERE TRANSPORTED TO THE HOSPITAL. ONE FOR OBSERVATION AND ONE FOR TREATMENT. - INCIDENT IS STILL UNDER INVESTIGATION. - LINE IS NOT DOT REGULATED. - THERE WAS NO PENN. "ONE CALL" MADE BEFORE THE WORK WAS STARTED. - PIPELINE TYPE IS CHANGED TO "OTHER". ORIGINAL REPORT: ///48HR UPDATE TO REPORT NUMBER 1343282/// THE UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWED: THE CALLER HAS UPDATED THE SRP. THE FIRE WAS EXTINGUISHED. 9TH AVE, SPRING AVE, LOCUST ST AND JENNY LIND AVE WERE CLOSED IN ALL DIRECTIONS. NO RAILROAD TRACKS WERE CLOSED. MEDIUM MEDIA COVERAGE. THE PIPELINE AND FACILITY HAS BEEN SECURED, THE CALLER CONTACTED THE PENNSYLVANIA PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION AND THE INVESTIGATION IS CURRENTLY UNDERWAY BY THE LOCAL FIRE DEPARTMENT. THE ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION IS AS FOLLOWED: THE CALLER IS REPORTING A RELEASE OF NATURAL GAS INTO THE ATMOSPHERE FROM A PIPELINE AT A COMMERCIAL BUILDING. THE CAUSE OF THE INCIDENT WAS DUE TO A THIRD PARTY CONTRACTOR STRIKING THE PIPE DURING EXCAVATION. THE STRIKE CAUSED THE NATURAL GAS TO IGNITE AND EXPLODE. THE EXPLOSION COLLAPSED PART OF THE BUILDING AND AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF INJURIES. THE CALLER STATES THAT FIRST RESPONDERS ARE ON SCENE TO SHUT OFF THE PIPELINE, EXTINGUISH THE FIRE, SECURE THE BUILDING AND TRANSPORT THE INJURED PARTIES.

THESE PASSENGERS WERE TRANSPORTED BY AMBULANCE TO NEARBY HOSPITALS FOR EVALUATION. NO EXTERNAL EVIDENCE OF INJURY WAS OBSERVED WITH ANY OF THE PASSENGERS WHO REPORTED INJURIES. THE DRIVER OF THE AUTOMOBILE AND HER TWO PASSENGERS WERE REMOVED FROM THE SCENE FOR MEDICAL EVALUATION. NO FATALITIES OR SERIOUS INJURIES WERE OBSERVED AT THE SCENE.
